summary: Independent reaudit of Jin Shu 53 (Sima Yu) owned units, claims, hints, and people. Chinese dates were read from the sealed units, not from the English glosses. Hui accession (惠帝即位) converts to AD 290; 元康元年 is the conventional AD 291 label; 元康九年六月 is AD 299 as a mid-year date; 元康九年十二月 falls entirely in AD 300 (month ends 十二月壬戌 = 300/2/6), so twelfth-month deposition events are AD 300, not 299; 明年正月 / 永康元年 is AD 300; 永甯/永寧元年 is AD 301; 太安元年三月 in Jin Shu's year-count is the 壬戌 spring (AD 302), even though 太安 was proclaimed only in the twelfth month. Verified month/day Western years are stated on the proleptic Gregorian year, which matches the pre-1582 Julian tables for these mid-year and January–February spans. Two defects: claim-104 dates Sima Yu from the year-9 mulberry omen, which is not his act; hints-p004 stores research prose instead of an empty hint list for undated 武帝愛之. Ages five and twenty-three sui are preserved without conversion to a birth year. Undated but positively attested facts keep undatedSourceAttestation. Posthumous titles and exempla stay on retrospective reception and do not feed living hints. Competing day/month graphs with the Hui annals (六月己卯 vs 六月壬寅; this chapter's 四月/八月 vs annals 五月) are retained and do not change the Western years. No owned birth is omitted because none is stated; owned deaths and ages in the units are recorded.
